questions.question: What feast did Hezekiah invite all Israel and Judah to keep?
How did many from the northern tribes respond to the couriers' invitation?
options: Some mocked, but some humbled themselves and came
They all gladly answered the king's invitation
They drove the couriers out of their towns
They sent gifts but refused to come down
questions.answer: Some mocked, but some humbled themselves and came
